description: Open-source skills for designing and reviewing software with AI agents

summary.one_liner: An Apache-2.0 plugin of agent skills for designing and reviewing software specs: a deep-context agent drafts the design, and fresh zero-context reviewer subagents stress-test it before any code is written.
summary.what_it_does: EGM (Elephant-Goldfish Model) is a set of skills installed as a plugin into coding agents such as Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex. The "elephant" agent holds project context, brainstorms with the user, and drafts a specification (concepts_brief.md, then design_draft.md) section by section with feedback in chat. "Goldfish" reviewers are fresh subagents that read only the document and its referenced source material, not the earlier conversation, to surface unstated assumptions and blind spots. Review runs across five stages and produces findings the user chooses to address. Other skills cover resolving review findings, bootstrapping docs for an existing codebase, running a configured group of reviewers (review loop), and comparing checked-in documents with current source code (drift report). The README says approved specs can be saved under docs/designs/ before implementation.
use_cases: Drafting a feature spec before implementation
Stress-testing a design document with fresh reviewer agents
Brainstorming requirements and trade-offs with an AI agent
Generating docs for an existing codebase
Detecting drift between design docs and source code
Running a multi-reviewer review loop on a document
how_to_run: Claude Code: claude plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model
Claude Code: claude plugin install egm@egm
Codex: codex plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model
Start a new session, then run /egm-brainstorm, /egm-draft, and /egm-review design_draft.md (prefix /egm: in Antigravity and Claude Code)
notable: Two-role design: a context-rich agent drafts, zero-context subagents review the document alone
Modular skills that can be used individually rather than as a fixed sequence
Works across Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex plugin systems
Review stage stops and reports if the agent cannot create fresh subagent contexts
Per-section drafting with user approval in chat before the spec is finalized
caveats: Goldfish reviews require an agent that can create fresh subagent contexts; otherwise EGM stops the review
Not a substitute for tests or human judgment, per the README
Intended for features needing design decisions; small clear bug fixes should use a normal workflow
README states it is not an officially supported Google product
